title: Mounts
intro: Choose mounts and parts for the troop type you actually use.

sections.title: Choose your mounts
items: For whales it is possible to have an army with one darkness or Destruction mount. As they offer slightly different Mount Skills, which are only available to those type of mounts.
Furthermore, a Destruction mount can also be used to boost the Skill Damage of an army focused on Skill Damage only.

sections.title: Where to invest
items: Only mounts/parts that boost attack and defense of their specific troop type are worth investing in, as seen above.
You should only invest in troop specific attack and defense mounts/parts.
(Health is never worth investing in as it gives the smallest stats increases and does not contribute towards shield factors)
Never invest in epic mounts or epic mount parts, its not worth it long term and is best to be patient and invest only in legendary mounts/parts.

sections.title: Balance attack and defense
items: For general purpouse/ field battles you should aim for 1 attack mount and 1 defense mount, 6 parts in total and 5 of them should be defense parts and 1 of them attack.
Theoretically all defense mounts is best for 1v1s/rallies, but when you are swarming a target the attack is more useful then defense.
Attack doesnt help much as the target will die if swarmed regardless, so we go majority defense and a little attack to find common ground.

Since you can't control when you are getting targeted having more defense then attack is crucial if you aim to get good trades, especially on your archers and infantry as they will get targeted a lot in battles.
